FAQ

Before you book

Prefer to talk? Call 1300 465 569.

Are your quotes all inclusive?

Yes: travel, petrol costs, labour, equipment and GST. In most cases tolls are covered; depending on location and distance, toll charges may be added. The rate may change if you add items or services.

Do you offer price matching?

Yes. Forward us the other removalist's email quote; if it's cheaper than ours, we will beat it. We only price match other AFRA-accredited removal companies.

Do you surcharge for stairs?

No. We don't charge extra for stairs or long walkways; allow a little more time for large items.

Is my move insured?

Every move has standard public liability and transit insurance up to $100,000. As an AFRA-accredited company we can also quote comprehensive cover against accidental loss and damage.

Do I need to pay a deposit?

Yes. Fixed price moves take a 50% deposit to allocate your team and truck, with the balance paid before moving day. Hourly moves take a 1 hour deposit.

What if I need to reschedule?

We have a 48 hour cancellation and reschedule policy. Changes with less than 24 hours notice incur a 2 hour labour charge at your quoted hourly rate.
